about: lane castgc17 (2026-10-17, CAST-GC): r108 room package = ps2-ch1-r108 with ganado-em17-0c replaced by the pool descriptor ganado-em17-0cp (as ps2-ch2-r113p / r118p; NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_POOL; built with --package-room 108 --pool --wide-identity). r108 spawns em17 type 0xc holding a weapon (body 0x1cd, head 0x1cf, TPL 0x1ce, hands 0x1c0 + grip 0x1c8): the non-pool descriptor has hands 0x1c0 / 0x1c5 only, so the registry refused it on role rows (NMRU roles) and the GameCube model drew (CAST-GC r108 em17, every pass).
